newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee weakens vs dlr on expected NOC demand.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee weakens vs dlr on expected NOC demand.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened weaker at 56.98/00 rupees per dollar on Wednesday, compared to the previous close of 56.95 rupees, dealers said.

"The rupee weakened as there is a large demand of $12 million for the import of petroleum products by the state owned Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC)," a dealer said. "The payment is due next week, but the supply is normal and there are no other major demands," he said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 4.0-5.0 percent on Wednesday, a dealer said.
